# gpupaas_high_speed_storage (Data Source)

Look up a high-speed storage volume by name within a project, optionally scoped to a workspace. Fails when the volume belongs to the other storage family.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gpupaas_high_speed_storage" "shared" {
  project   = "system-catalog"
  workspace = "team-a"
  name      = "training-data"
}

output "size" {
  value = data.gpupaas_high_speed_storage.shared.spec.size
}
```
